errors.debuggingNotEnabled: Error: Could not connect to the SDB Daemon. Are you sure you changed the Host PC IP to 127.0.0.1? If you have, hold the power button till you see the Samsung logo.
errors.githubRateLimit: GitHub limit reached: without a token GitHub allows only 60 requests per hour. Try again after {{time}}, or add a GitHub token on the home screen (GitHub token).
errors.githubRateLimitWithToken: GitHub limit reached even with your token. Try again after {{time}}.
errors.githubBadToken: GitHub rejected the saved token (expired, revoked or mistyped). Replace or remove it on the home screen (GitHub token).

resigning.resigningRequiredDesc:
Since Tizen 7, all packages must be resigned with a Samsung Certificate.
Please scan the QR code to sign in to your Samsung account and then copy the response JSON you get after signing in.
resigning.resigningRequiredPCDesc:
Since Tizen 7, all packages must be resigned with a Samsung Certificate.
Please click the button below to sign in to your Samsung account.
resigning.resigningRequiredAccessInfo: After copying the JSON response, go into http://{{ip}}:4794 and paste it into the input field and press the "Submit" button.
resigning.resigningDeviceSameNetwork: Make sure your device is on the same network as your TV.

installer.installingAgain: TizenBrew Installer is installed as an USB Demo Package. It will now be reinstalled as a normal package.
installer.alreadyInstalled: TizenBrew Installer as an USB Demo Package is installed. You can now uninstall it.
installer.latestUnavailable: Could not check latest version online.

installerDesktop.sdbConnectionRefused: Could not connect to the SDB Daemon. Make sure that the TV is on and that the IP is correct.
installerDesktop.sdbConnectionReset: Could not connect to the SDB Daemon. Either you haven't set the Host PC IP to this device's IP, or you didn't restart the TV properly. Hold the power button till you see the Samsung logo to restart the TV.

savedRepos.pageDesc: Select a repo to set it active. Use ◀▶ for Lock / Version / Install / Delete.
savedRepos.empty: No saved repos yet. Install from GitHub to add one.
savedRepos.hint: ◀▶ switch action  |  OK = confirm  |  ▲▼ switch repo
savedRepos.pickerError: Could not load versions from GitHub.
savedRepos.changesNone: No release notes or commits found.

repoLists.title: Repo lists
repoLists.addHint: File on GitHub with one owner/repo per line. Example: owner/repo/repos.md (optional @branch). Press OK to add.
repoLists.invalid: Not a valid list path. Use owner/repo/path/file.md (.md, .txt or .list).
repoLists.error: could not load, kept as is
repoLists.syncFailed: Could not load a repo list, nothing removed
repoLists.syncUpToDate: Repo lists are up to date

githubToken.desc: Raises the GitHub limit from 60 to 5000 requests per hour
githubToken.title: GitHub token
githubToken.explain: Without a token GitHub allows only 60 requests per hour per network, which version checks and installs use up quickly. A free token raises that to 5000. It only needs read access to public repositories and is stored on this TV only.
githubToken.phoneHint: Scan the code with a phone on the same network. The page there helps you create the token and sends it to the TV.
githubToken.noAddress: The TV address could not be found. Enter the token on the right instead.
githubToken.manualTitle: Or type or paste it here
githubToken.manualHint: Press OK to save. Create one at github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new (public repositories, no extra permissions).
githubToken.invalid: That does not look like a GitHub token (it starts with github_pat_ or ghp_).
githubToken.receivedToast: GitHub token received from your phone and saved.
